findings.detail: scene 1: must_understand 2 «asks what you are here for» has no answer in must_say

scenes.topic_description:
Situation: You arrive at the bank branch for a scheduled appointment to open an account. This is the first contact before the main meeting. The learner does not have a permanent address, but that issue is not decided here and will be handled with the bank employee.
Learner: Customer. Partner: Receptionist.
Not in this scene: account type, address requirements, proof of address, fees, card delivery, next steps after approval.
must_say: say you have an appointment — slot: the time
give your name — slot: the name
say why you are here — slot: the purpose
answer whether you have identification — slot: the document
ask whether a document is needed — slot: the document
ask where to wait — slot: none
must_understand: asks your name and whether you have an appointment
asks what you are here for
asks whether you have identification
tells you which document they need first
tells you where to wait or where to go

scenes.topic_description:
Situation: In the appointment, you sit with a bank employee to open an account. The key complication is that you do not have a permanent address, so the meeting depends on documents, alternatives and whether the bank can proceed today.
Learner: Customer. Partner: Bank employee.
Not in this scene: checking in at reception, giving your appointment time, asking where to wait.
must_say: say what kind of account you want — slot: the account type
answer what you will use the account for — slot: the purpose
answer whether you have a permanent address — slot: the address status
ask whether another document is acceptable — slot: the document
ask what you can use instead of proof of address — slot: the document
ask whether you can still open the account — slot: none
ask how long the process takes — slot: none
must_understand: asks what kind of account you want and what you will use it for
asks for proof of address and identification
says a permanent address is normally required
offers acceptable alternatives or explains the condition
tells you whether the account can be opened now or later
